FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... we must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to unveil his vision. He dons a sleek, neon-lit crown, and his armor is replaced with a shimmering, iridescent jumpsuit.

KING
(to his courtiers)
Behold! The future of our empire!

COURTIER 1 (she)
(stunned)
Your Majesty, what... what have you done?

KING
(smiling)
I have taken the essence of our empire's grandeur and distilled it into a... a... (he searches for the right words)...a proto-vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The stone walls are now adorned with neon-lit, pixelated murals. The knights ride by on hoverbikes, their armor replaced with sleek, metallic jumpsuits. The peasants scurry about, wearing futuristic, high-tech clothing.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(sarcastically)
Yes, Your Majesty. It's a... a... (he searches for the right words)...a bold new direction.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, sits on a throne made of gleaming, metallic chrome. He addresses the assembly.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must... we must... (he searches for the right words)...we must make our empire the envy of all the land. We must... we must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave the world!

COURTIER 2 (he)
(excitedly)
Yes, Your Majesty! We can do it!

KING
(smiling)
I knew you would see it my way.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a hub of futuristic activity. Knights and peasants alike are busy constructing neon-lit, high-tech contraptions. The air is filled with the hum of machinery and the chatter of excited courtiers.

KING
(to Zorvath)
We are on the cusp of a new era, my friend. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of vaporwave greatness.

ZORVATH
(sighing)
Yes, Your Majesty. We are indeed.

FADE TO BLACK.
